comparison.method: Join original and fresh manifests by PNG basename; require exactly 16 frames in each; verify each actual PNG SHA-256 against its own manifest; require original and fresh PNG SHA-256 equality for every pair. Verify the original ACCEPT review fingerprint binds its unchanged original manifest, and the fresh fingerprint matches current sourceRoots.
